```{r setup, include=FALSE}
ENIA_ROOT <- "~/ENIA-5120"
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
league_df <- readr::read_csv(file.path(ENIA_ROOT, "data", "laser_league_players.csv"))
```

```{r}
hist_plot <- ggplot(league_df, aes(season_score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median(season_score, na.rm = TRUE)), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Season Score Distribution", x = "Season score", y = "Count")
hist_plot
```

```{r}
box_plot <- ggplot(league_df, aes(role, tag_accuracy_pct)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "gray85") +
  labs(title = "Tag Accuracy by Role", x = "Role", y = "Tag accuracy (%)") +
  theme_minimal()
box_plot
```

```{r}
scatter_plot <- ggplot(league_df, aes(assists, season_score, color = preferred_loadout)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ home_arena) +
  labs(title = "Assists vs Season Score", x = "Assists", y = "Season score") +
  theme_minimal()
scatter_plot
```
